shortDescription: The DAX Index went up by 142 points or 0.56 percent on Friday to close at 25409 points.The rise was led by Adidas (2.99%), Commerzbank (2.73%) and Deutsche Bank (2.68%).On the downside, the weakerst performers were BASF (-3.59%), BMW (-1.31%) and Rheinmetall (-1.07%).
